target_customer: Consumers who save posts, links and images from many apps and want to organize and show them
problem: People bookmark content across social apps and websites, where saved items are scattered and hard to find or share.
business_model: Consumer app (Chrome extension and mobile apps); monetization not found
product_category: Social bookmarking and content organization app

founders.name: Cristina Bunea
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her as co-founder of Listle/Odin and later in growth at CommandBar (S20).

founders.name: Radu Mazilu
prior_employers: Fleek (W22), as founding engineer, after Odin
founders.background_notes: YC page says he previously developed 700MW of clean energy projects in Europe.

founders.name: Maria Nicolae
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page as a founder; no employers or education given.

exit.reason: Cause not public. AlternativeTo flags the product as discontinued with website and apps unavailable.

technical_complexity.rationale: A browser extension and mobile share sheet saving content to a user feed is standard consumer engineering, with some work to parse posts from many apps.

defensibility.rationale: Bookmarking tools were numerous and easy to switch between; no data or network lock-in beyond user collections.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; the product was later discontinued.

market_need_then: Not independently sourced beyond the product's own description of saving posts from many apps.

branding.domain_note: Used savewithodin.com, not odin.com; no source on how it was obtained.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline 'Save, organize and showcase your mental dump' is casual and personal.

rebrands.why: Inferred from a founder bio saying Listle/Odin; no source states the reason

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand; the name is shared with many other companies, which clouds search.

pivots.from: Listle, an app to listen to articles (per Crunchbase)
pivots.to: Odin, save and organize posts from any app
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the founder bio naming Listle/Odin

outcome_analysis: Odin was a four person consumer startup in the Summer 2019 batch that let users save and organize posts and links from any app. It left little public trace: no funding amount or press on its decline, the Chrome extension was last updated in August 2021, and a directory marks the product discontinued. The cause of the shutdown is not public, so no failure factors are assigned; the founders went on to other startups.
notes: savewithodin.com returned HTTP 503 when fetched, so the site's state is unconfirmed. Crunchbase and CB Insights show a Listle entry (audio articles, Mountain View, 2019) with Y Combinator as the only investor and no amount; this is YC's standard deal and not recorded as a round, and the Listle link to Odin rests on one founder bio line. A funding search for Odin returned only an unrelated London investment platform, which was excluded. Competitors left empty: AlternativeTo names Raindrop.io and Pinboard but the page is undated and a TechCrunch Kippt article is far older than the batch. The Round Funded page is a reconstruction and was not used.
